name: v25-11-L3-real-old-chat
objective: v2.5 plan 11 L3, run WITHOUT --sandbox against a real v3 chat of 'Adolion - The Adventurer's Road' (group 1789797226071) on a LANE COPY of the install, opened beforehand with st-navigation open-group + open-chat. The chat shows the one unreadable notice, a player's selection is refused with its bytes kept, a confirmed Restart starts adolion-adventurer, one real turn answers, and the server holds a v5 blob for this chat with engineHistory, visitedPath and pinnedStory while the chat keeps its messages.

steps.eval: const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 1500)); const blob = ctx.chatMetadata.story_orchestrator ?? null; const snapshot = rt.getSnapshot(); let nodes = document.querySelectorAll('#so-blob-unreadable'); for (let waited = 0; waited < 3000 && !nodes.length; waited += 100) { await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 100)); nodes = document.querySelectorAll('#so-blob-unreadable'); } const response = await fetch('/api/chats/group/get', { method: 'POST', headers: ctx.getRequestHeaders(), body: JSON.stringify({ id: ctx.chatId }) }); const lines = response.ok ? await response.json() : null; const onServer = Array.isArray(lines) ? lines[0]?.chat_metadata?.story_orchestrator ?? null : null; const result = { groupId: ctx.groupId, chatId: ctx.chatId, version: blob?.version ?? null, selected: blob?.selectedStoryId ?? null, messages: ctx.chat.length, serverMessages: Array.isArray(lines) ? lines.length - 1 : null, storyId: snapshot.storyId, flagged: snapshot.blobUnreadable ?? null, notices: nodes.length, notice: nodes[0]?.textContent ?? null, serverIdentical: JSON.stringify(onServer) === JSON.stringify(blob) }; if (result.groupId !== '1789797226071' || !result.chatId) throw new Error(`not on an Adventurer's Road chat: ${JSON.stringify(result)}`); if (result.version !== 3) throw new Error(`this chat does not hold a v3 blob: ${JSON.stringify(result)}`); if (result.storyId !== null) throw new Error(`a v3 blob was read as a story: ${JSON.stringify(result)}`); if (result.flagged?.foundVersion !== 3) throw new Error(`the snapshot does not flag the v3 blob: ${JSON.stringify(result)}`); if (result.notices !== 1 || !String(result.notice).includes('saved by another version of Story Orchestrator: Restart to replace it')) throw new Error(`#so-blob-unreadable is not shown exactly once: ${JSON.stringify(result)}`); if (!result.serverIdentical) throw new Error(`opening the chat changed the server's blob: ${JSON.stringify(result)}`); globalThis.__v2511L3 = { seed: JSON.stringify(blob), chatId: ctx.chatId, messages: ctx.chat.length }; return result;

const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const ok = await rt.selectStory('adolion-adventurer'); const snapshot = rt.getSnapshot(); const result = { selected: ok, storyId: snapshot.storyId, status: snapshot.status ?? null }; if (ok || result.storyId !== null) throw new Error(`the selection of a chat with a v3 blob was not refused: ${JSON.stringify(result)}`); return { refused: true, status: result.status };

const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const before = globalThis.__v2511L3; await ctx.saveMetadata(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 1500)); const response = await fetch('/api/chats/group/get', { method: 'POST', headers: ctx.getRequestHeaders(), body: JSON.stringify({ id: ctx.chatId }) }); if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`could not read the chat file back: HTTP ${response.status}`); const lines = await response.json(); const onServer = lines[0]?.chat_metadata?.story_orchestrator ?? null; const result = { chatId: ctx.chatId, storyId: globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getSnapshot().storyId, inMemoryIdentical: JSON.stringify(ctx.chatMetadata.story_orchestrator) === before.seed, identical: JSON.stringify(onServer) === before.seed, serverMessages: lines.length - 1 }; if (result.chatId !== before.chatId) throw new Error(`the page left the chat: ${JSON.stringify(result)}`); if (result.storyId !== null) throw new Error(`the selection was not refused: ${JSON.stringify(result)}`); if (!result.inMemoryIdentical || !result.identical) throw new Error(`the v3 blob did not survive a refused selection byte-for-byte: ${JSON.stringify(result)}`); return result;

const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const snapshot = rt.getSnapshot(); const result = { chatId: SillyTavern.getContext().chatId, storyId: snapshot.storyId, activeCheckpointId: snapshot.activeCheckpointId, flagged: snapshot.blobUnreadable ?? null, notices: document.querySelectorAll('#so-blob-unreadable').length, requirements: snapshot.requirements, journaled: JSON.stringify(rt.getSessionJournal()).includes('blob-unreadable: replaced on a confirmed Restart') }; if (result.chatId !== globalThis.__v2511L3.chatId) throw new Error(`the page left the chat: ${JSON.stringify(result)}`); if (result.storyId !== 'adolion-adventurer' || result.flagged) throw new Error(`a confirmed Restart did not start the refused story: ${JSON.stringify(result)}`); if (!result.journaled) throw new Error(`the replacement was not journaled: ${JSON.stringify(result)}`); return result;

send_generate.text: I shoulder my pack and ask the others which way the road runs from here.
